summary: Closure review of a preregistered paired confirmatory study (n=200) comparing LLM-only generation to a deterministic GVR pipeline. Execution artifacts show complete accounting and a degenerate null result (n11=200, no discordant pairs). The manuscript is scientifically honest about the null outcome and preregistration, but two prior required revisions remain unresolved: (1) the manuscript still includes low‑level artifact paths/hashes in main prose rather than concise pointers to the archived bundle, and (2) runtime sampling/determinism semantics remain ambiguous (model_configuration.json lists "temperature": null while the paper claims deterministic shared_initial enforcement) and are not explicitly reconciled with cited artifacts. These defects are resolvable using the supplied artifacts and must be fixed before finalisation.
critical_issues: Main manuscript still embeds raw artifact file paths and full hashes in Methods/Results/Disclosure, producing an artifact‑inventory style rather than concise scholarly prose. This violates the prior required revision and must be corrected by removing per‑file paths/hashes from the main text and replacing them with short canonical pointers to the archived execution bundle.

Unresolved determinism/sampling semantics: model_configuration.json records "temperature": null, yet the paper claims adapter‑enforced deterministic shared_initial generation. The Methods must explicitly reconcile how determinism was achieved (temperature setting vs adapter enforcement), cite the exact archived artifacts that demonstrate enforcement (e.g., execution/model_configuration.json, deterministic_reconciliation.json, provider call audit fields), and explain the consequence for inferential claims. This clarification is required and can be completed from existing artifacts.
required_revisions: Remove low‑level artifact paths, per‑file JSON snippets, and full hashes from the main manuscript prose (Methods/Results/Discussion/Disclosure). Replace them with concise descriptive statements and explicit short pointers to the archived execution bundle (e.g., "archived execution bundle: execution/raw_results.jsonl, deterministic_reconciliation.json; see artifact manifest"). Move detailed provenance (file listings, JSON examples, full hashes) into the supplied artifact index or a single compact appendix section within the five pages.

Explicitly reconcile runtime determinism/sampling semantics in Methods: state whether model calls used temperature=0 or whether determinism was achieved by adapter enforcement despite model_configuration.json listing "temperature": null. Cite the archived artifacts that demonstrate enforcement (execution/model_configuration.json, deterministic_reconciliation.json, execution/execution_log.jsonl or provider audit fields) and explain how those artifacts prove single shared_initial invocations per task and remove sampling variance. Make this clarification from existing artifacts (no new experiments).
optional_revisions: Shorten Related Work to prioritize closest verifier‑assisted and GVR studies and move broader survey material to compact references to save space.

Add a brief note (one short paragraph) in Methods explaining the interpretation limits of bootstrap percentile CIs and exact McNemar inference in the degenerate paired case with zero discordant pairs.

If space permits, include a very compact 1‑row mapping table that links each major empirical claim (e.g., pair accounting, model‑calls used, no repair events, contamination check result) to a single canonical archived artifact name/path (kept extremely concise).
